title: Solution Methods for Infinite-Dimensional Generalized Disjunctive Programming
summary: Generalized disjunctive programming (GDP) expresses mixed discrete-continuous decisions through Boolean indicators and disjunctions, and can be systematically solved via a library of methods proposed in the literature. The recent InfiniteGDP abstraction lifts this modeling layer to continuous domains such as time, space, and uncertainty, but only the big-M and hull reformulations, the two endpoints of the relaxation spectrum, have been generalized to the infinite setting.
